subject: Three-horizon exec sync — scheduling & DST planning
messages:
From: Liang Zhao <liang.zhao@cloudcorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma O'Sullivan <emma@finopt.com>, APAC Scheduling <apac-sched@partnerco.io>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + exec demo — aligning 3-region panel

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro — we'd like to lock a short executive demo with cross-functional execs from CloudCorp and Redwood. High level ask: a 45-minute run-through (30 min demo, 15 min Q&A) with at least one exec from each region (US, EU, APAC). Our execs are: Liang Zhao (CloudCorp, NA), Emma O'Sullivan (FinOpt, EU), and Rajiv Menon (APAC lead, Singapore).

Rough availability (local times) on our side the week of Jul 30: 
- NA: Jul 30–Aug 2, mornings PT (8–11am PT) or late afternoons ET (4–6pm ET)
- EU: Jul 30–Aug 3, mid-afternoon (3–6pm BST)
- APAC: Jul 31–Aug 2, early mornings SGT (7–10am) or late evenings (9–11pm)

We realize this is a tough overlap — happy to be flexible if we establish a single UTC slot and rotate future sessions to accommodate local DST changes (we have some recurring quarterly meetings coming up).

Attached org chart for reference.

Thanks — Liang

[Attachment: Current_OrgChart.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liang Zhao <liang.zhao@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Emma O'Sullivan <emma@finopt.com>, APAC Scheduling <apac-sched@partnerco.io>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + exec demo — aligning 3-region panel

Thanks Liang — looping in our execs and solutions leads.

Quick read: Marcus (US west) and Karthik (EU) confirmed they can join if we pick a time that hits early morning PST / mid-afternoon BST / late evening SGT. Priyom (APAC) can do morning SGT but prefers we avoid slots later than 22:30 SGT.

Two candidate slots in UTC that create reasonable overlaps (please confirm which works for your execs):

A) Tue Jul 30, 15:00 UTC — converts to 08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 16:00 BST / 23:00 SGT (Jul 31)
B) Tue Jul 30, 18:00 UTC — converts to 11:00 PDT / 14:00 EDT / 19:00 BST / 02:00 SGT (Jul 31, not ideal for APAC)

Prefer A for APAC friendliness; we can do a 45-minute session starting at 15:00 UTC. Note: if we end up scheduling the recurring series into late Oct/Nov, we'll need to rotate the window because EU and US DST end on different dates — happy to propose a rotation plan once this one-off is confirmed.

Attached is a brief mutual-action-plan template and a lightweight agenda. If you can confirm which slot (A or B) and who will attend from CloudCorp and APAC, I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in and recording enabled.

Thanks,
Hannah
--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Karthik
